Requirement: Requirement : Verify that the eUICC SHALL ignore the ICCID value provided in the 'ProfileHeader' PE. [eUICC, ICCID, ProfileHeader PE]
Requirement : Confirm that the eUICC SHALL verify the ICCID in the Profile Metadata matches the value in EF ICCID. [eUICC, Profile Metadata, EF ICCID]
Requirement : Check if EF IMSI SHALL be present in the Profile when profileOwner is provided in the Profile Metadata. [eUICC, Profile Metadata, EF IMSI, profileOwner]
Requirement : Verify that the mccMnc value in Profile Metadata matches the MCC and MNC values in EF IMSI. [eUICC, Profile Metadata, mccMnc, EF IMSI]

Requirement : Check that if gid1 or gid2 is provided in the Profile Metadata, the corresponding EF GID1 or EF GID2 SHALL be present and contain the same value, and the related service in EF UST SHALL indicate 'available'. [eUICC, Profile Metadata, gid1, gid2, EF GID1, EF GID2, EF UST]

Requirement : Verify that if gid1 or gid2 is not provided in the Profile Metadata, the corresponding service in EF UST for EF GID1 or EF GID2 SHALL indicate 'not available'. [eUICC, Profile Metadata, gid1, gid2, EF GID1, EF GID2, EF UST]
Requirement : Check that any failure in Profile Metadata checks SHALL be indicated by an installFailedDueToDataMismatch error. [eUICC, installFailedDueToDataMismatch]

Requirement : Verify the eUICC SHALL stop Profile installation and delete the ISD-P and all related Profile Components upon any error during processing of a Profile Element. [eUICC, Profile Element, ISD-P]

Requirement : Verify that if Profile installation is successful, the eUICC SHALL first generate the Profile Installation Result and then as many Notifications as configured in its metadata (notificationConfigurationInfo) in the format of OtherSignedNotification. [eUICC, Profile Installation Result, notificationConfigurationInfo, OtherSignedNotification]
Requirement : Check that on failed installation, the eUICC SHALL only generate the Profile Installation Result with an error indication. [eUICC, Profile Installation Result]
Requirement : Confirm the LPA SHALL communicate with the SM-DP+ using HTTPS in server authentication mode. [LPA, SM-DP+, HTTPS]
Requirement : Verify that during TLS establishment, the LPA SHALL verify the received CERT.DP.TLS according to section 4.5.2.2. [LPA, CERT.DP.TLS]
Requirement : Check that if any TLS certificate verification fails, the TLS connection SHALL be rejected, and the on-going procedure SHALL fail. [LPA, TLS]

Requirement : Verify that when ES9+.InitiateAuthentication is executed, if the CI Public Key or the chain variant does not match, the SM-DP+ returns a status code CI Public Key - Unknown [SM-DP+, CI Public Key].
Requirement : Verify that the eUICC signature (euiccSignature1) is validated using PK.EUICC.SIG; if verification fails, SM-DP+ returns eUICC - Verification failed [SM-DP+, eUICC].
Requirement : Verify that if the transactionId is unknown or not related to an ongoing RSP Session, SM-DP+ returns a status code TransactionId - Unknown [SM-DP+, transactionId].
Requirement : Verify that the serverChallenge for an ongoing RSP Session matches the one returned by the eUICC; otherwise, SM-DP+ returns eUICC - Verification failed [SM-DP+, serverChallenge].
Requirement : Verify that if the Profile download order or RPM order has expired before being downloaded, SM-DP+ returns Download order - Time to Live Expired [SM-DP+, Download order].

Requirement : Verify that if the maximum download attempts for Profile or RPM has been exceeded, SM-DP+ terminates the order and returns Download order - Maximum number of attempts exceeded [SM-DP+, Download order].
Requirement : If euiccRspCapInInfo1 is set to '1', verify that euiccRspCapability in euiccInfo2 matches euiccInfo1; otherwise, SM-DP+ returns eUICC - Value has Changed [SM-DP+, euiccRspCapability].
Requirement : Verify that lpaRspCapability in deviceInfo matches the value received in ES9+.InitiateAuthentication; otherwise, SM-DP+ returns LPA - Value has Changed [SM-DP+, lpaRspCapability].

Requirement : If there was an associated event registration and a Profile/RPM order expired/terminated, SM-DP+ SHOULD send ES12.DeleteEvent to the corresponding SM-DS to delete the Event Record [SM-DP+, Event Registration].
Requirement : Verify that the SM-DP+ determines the type of operation requested by the LPA based on ctxParams1 [SM-DP+, ctxParams1].
Requirement : If ctxParamsForCommonAuthentication contains operationType profileDownload only, SM-DP+ treats this as a Profile download request [SM-DP+, operationType].
Requirement : If ctxParamsForCommonAuthentication contains operationType rpm only, SM-DP+ treats this as an RPM download request [SM-DP+, operationType].
Requirement : If ctxParamsForDeviceChange exists, SM-DP+ treats this as a Device Change request [SM-DP+, ctxParamsForDeviceChange].
Requirement : If ctxParamsForProfileRecovery exists, SM-DP+ treats this as a Profile Recovery request [SM-DP+, ctxParamsForProfileRecovery].
Requirement : If none of the above ctxParams data objects are present, SM-DP+ returns Function – Unsupported [SM-DP+, Error Handling].

Requirement : Verify that for a Profile download order, if MatchingId is provided in ctxParamsForCommonAuthentication, only the matching Profile download order is selected; if no match, return MatchingID - Refused [SM-DP+, MatchingId].
Requirement : If MatchingID is absent in ctxParamsForCommonAuthentication and no pending Profile download order exists for this EID, return EID Refused [SM-DP+, MatchingId].
Requirement : If Delete Notification for Device Change is required and not received, SM-DP+ returns error status Profile – Not Allowed [SM-DP+, Delete Notification].
Requirement : If identified Profile in download order is not released, SM-DP+ returns Profile - Not allowed [SM-DP+, Profile State].
Requirement : Verify that if the eUICC does not have sufficient memory for the Profile, SM-DP+ returns eUICC - Insufficient memory [SM-DP+, Insufficient Memory].
Requirement : If Profile is a Test Profile, check if Device is in Device Test Mode; otherwise, SM-DP+ returns Profile type - Stopped on warning [SM-DP+, Test Profile].
Requirement : If Profile Owner disallows download to Field-Test eUICCs (ppVersion == V255.255.255), SM-DP+ returns Profile Type Stopped on warning [SM-DP+, Field-Test eUICC].
Requirement : If RPM order and ICCID are received, and no matching RPM order or ICCID mismatch occurs, SM-DP+ returns ICCID Refused [SM-DP+, RPM Order].
Requirement : If MatchingID is absent and no matching RPM order for the target Profile exists, SM-DP+ returns ICCID – Refused [SM-DP+, RPM Order].
Requirement : If no pending RPM order is associated with the EID, verification fails and EID - Refused is returned [SM-DP+, RPM Order].
Requirement : If SM-DP+ does not support Device Change, it returns error status Device Change – Unsupported [SM-DP+, Device Change].
Requirement : If Profile cannot be identified by ICCID in ctxParamsForDeviceChange, SM-DP+ returns ICCID – Unknown [SM-DP+, Device Change].
Requirement : If identified Profile in Device Change is not associated with the EID of the incoming eUICC, SM-DP+ returns EID – Refused [SM-DP+, Device Change].
Requirement : If Profile in Profile Recovery cannot be identified or not processed for Device Change previously, SM-DP+ returns ICCID – Unknown [SM-DP+, Profile Recovery].
Requirement : If Profile in Profile Recovery is not associated with the EID of the old Device, SM-DP+ returns EID – Refused [SM-DP+, Profile Recovery].
Requirement : If there was no permanent error while installing the prepared Profile on the new Device for Device Change, SM-DP+ returns Profile – Not allowed [SM-DP+, Profile Recovery].
Requirement : When an LPA calls HandleNotification, the SM-DP+ SHALL manage the Notification as per section 3.5 and acknowledge processing [SM-DP+, Notification].
